blockers: Independent quality/accuracy evaluation and long-audio load tests not performed
DAW integration not authorized in this phase
scope: private cloud evaluation; no local weight/audio copy
dependency_notes: Torch/Torchaudio 2.10.0+cu128 pinned for RTX5090; independent environment
Only inference dependencies installed for SCNet; universal training/GUI CLI stack omitted
Source files unmodified; narrow loader requires strict checkpoint/state matching

cli.arguments: scnet --input <cloud audio> --output <new cloud results directory> --device cuda
cli.constraint: Only one root-authorized GPU workload; bounded CLI input <=120s, tested only8s

support_limits: Four stems only: drums, bass, other, vocals; not lead/backing vocals or separate guitars/keyboards.

guard_change_after_gpu_probes.change: Exceptional monitor/cleanup now TERM-then-KILL and durable terminal receipt; final diagnostic errors separate
